rows.title: Overview data: book stages, submissions, steps, steps-done counts and leads flag
rows.notes: Data layer only, read only. useOverviewBook() returns { book, submissions, steps: { dueSoon, doneByDay }, hasLeads, hasServicing, isLoading, isError, refetch }; the return shape is documented at the top of the hook. Book needs migration 193 (agent_clients); until it is applied book.available is false and the numbers are null. Saves need servicing_tasks.outcome (193) and read 0 until then. Spec: brain/ohvara/Agent Portal Servicing Spec.md, Overview.

rows.title: agent_products: what each agent has and how much of this week's limit is used
rows.notes: Not applied. Reads plan size and price from the agent_billing_tiers rows (test prices, price_is_test true) and the count from agent_weekly_usage. Checkout's price can differ until Billing goal fe2f2055 moves it.

rows.title: Submit's limit and the policies trigger read agent_products
rows.notes: Not applied. At the limit Submit and a direct insert raise usage_text, hint weekly_cap. Leads-only stays hint no_servicing. A VA booking is not refused and counts toward the agent's limit. SubmitDeal.jsx:170 adds its own reset sentence after the message, so the reset day repeats.

rows.title: Every text and call to the client: when, words or call result, who
rows.notes: contact_log is migration 199, written and not applied; tests pass in the local stand-in only. It returns label, text_status, has_recording and is_sample after the 16 original columns. Words on follow-up, recovery and workflow texts show once 198 lands and stay null until then, with no dependency on it. 177 isn't on Ohvara, so follow-up texts return no rows until it is applied.

rows.title: Fulfillment and cancellation calls show on the client's contact log
rows.notes: Never 'live' while voice_live is off. Covered in 199 by two client call sources: policy_events (no_answer, in_progress, cancelled) and fulfillment_voice_legs (party client). Written, not applied.

rows.title: A call on the client page says when a recording exists
rows.notes: Never 'live' while recording_live is off. Covered in 199 by has_recording: true on a client leg whose conference (conference_sid, same policy) has a fulfillment_recordings row with status ready. An agent gets only the true/false, never the audio, sid or id, and no grant was added. Before recording_live goes on: fulfillment-voice's leg callback sets conference_sid to null when Twilio sends none, which would keep this false.

rows.title: Texts and calls card: every text and call with the full words, both time zones, All / Texts / Calls
rows.notes: ContactLogCard calls rpc contact_log (migration 199) with p_client_key / p_lead. Words show when stored, otherwise the row label. A missing function shows a quiet muted note, any other failure shows the error with Try again. Not mounted yet: the client-page task mounts it.

rows.title: Team thread card: the client thread with Fulfillment, switcher for several policies, composer
rows.notes: TeamThreadCard reads useThreadMessages and sends through the existing useSendMessage (policy_messages). Opens on the newest policy. Not mounted yet: the client-page task mounts it.

rows.title: Activity card: calls booked, tried and finished on the client, newest first
rows.notes: ClientActivityCard reads policy_events for the client policies, newest first, 50 at most. Not mounted yet: the client-page task mounts it.

rows.title: A submit shows as one row: Submitted for servicing
rows.notes: Migration 202 (not applied). policy_events kind submitted reads kind servicing, title Submitted for servicing; it never reads detail.label. The drawer still shows the raw word submitted (Activity.jsx storyStep has no case for it): page work, not in this row.

rows.title: Requests and lapse work read in plain words
rows.notes: Migration 202 (not applied). lapse_save is checked first: Lapse risk flagged., then by outcome, with Lapse work done. for no outcome, which is what a done lapse_save reads until 200 lets a role write outcome. Agent or client requests read Request opened and Request done. System steps keep their words. The done row now passes outcome in reason.

rows.title: Every VA attempt and transfer change gets its own row
rows.notes: Migration 202 (not applied). Trigger log_lead_call_events on leads (insert or update of va_attempts, transfer_status, transferred_at) writes inbound_events va_call and transferred. The feed reads those and hides a column row only behind its own kind, with no date window. These rows also land on the lead timeline, and they raise the agent header count (DashboardLayout.jsx ActivityLine counts done inbound_events rows).

rows.title: Text rows come from every source, confirmed sends only
rows.notes: Migration 202 (not applied). text_auto adds recovery_sms_log where ok and skipped is null, and inbound_events text_sent and reminder rows that are done and hold a Twilio id. The titles are per kind, but Activity.jsx rowText still says follow-up text for all but just_submitted: page work.

rows.title: Lead spend changes show, private from the upline
rows.notes: Migration 202 (not applied). One log row gives one row: billing_spend_pause when the pause state changed (paused or resumed), else billing_spend_change. An upline gets zero, even passing p_agent; Fulfillment gets zero. billing_subscription stays pending and a plan change needs 201. PENDING_KINDS is unchanged, so the Billing chip stays hidden until that is flipped.

rows.title: Your book: Protected, Setting up, Needs attention, Requests open
rows.notes: Four tiles from useOverviewBook().book, each a link to /agent/clients?stage=<key> (protected, setting_up, needs_attention, requests). Clients.jsx does not read these keys yet and falls back to the Booked tab: follow-up for the Clients goal is "Clients should read these stage keys". Until migration 193 is applied (agent_clients missing) every tile shows a dash and a plain note, never a zero. Loading shows dashes; a failed load shows LoadError with Try again.

rows.title: This week: X of N submissions used, resets Monday
rows.notes: From agent_weekly_usage (7 or 16 from the plan), opens /agent/submit. Limit reached shows in the needs token. Loading shows dashes; failed load shows LoadError. On the phone the submissions ring card is the same number.

rows.title: Coming up: next steps with a due date
rows.notes: Open steps with a due_at (review calls, packet checks, annual reviews), soonest first, each linking to the client. The data hook leaves out chargeback_watch and requests; lapse_save is a request there, so it does not show here (the mockup lists lapse saves: open question for the hook). The caught-up box keeps its call list headed "Up next". Empty, loading and error states in plain words.

rows.title: Steps done: last Monday to Sunday in four kinds (replaces Booked / Cancelled)
rows.notes: Stacked bar per day: packet checks, review calls, cancellations, saves, on the LastWeekChart classes. The Booked / Cancelled chart and trend cards are gone from the agent Overview (Fulfillment still uses LastWeekChart). With servicing_tasks.outcome missing the chart still renders and Saves shows a dash.

rows.title: The whole Today strip shows only for agents who have Leads
rows.notes: hasLeads (leads_weekly_cents > 0 or any inbound) shows TodayStrip / TodayCards; otherwise one small Get leads card opens /agent/leads. A paused Leads buyer (leads_weekly_cents 0 with inbounds) keeps today's appointments. On the phone Texts waiting stays for agents with Leads.

rows.title: Leads-only agents (has_servicing false): Leads panels fill the page
rows.notes: Hides Your book, This week, Coming up and Steps done; the five Today cards and the Texts waiting box sit in three columns and two rows with no hole. Same test as Submit.jsx:37. scripts/overview-fit-shots.mjs measures Servicing only, Leads only, Both and a paused buyer at 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 1280x700.

rows.title: A service request moves through functions, not Fulfillment's direct status grant
rows.notes: Migration 196 (not applied). Fulfillment schedules and finishes an agent request through fulfillment_schedule_request and fulfillment_finish_request, and the agent reads the result in agent_my_service_requests. Fulfillment's direct update (status) grant on servicing_tasks is left as it was in 196; closing it is the next step on the Fulfillment Build Order, Lane A item 2, once the queue functions are live.

rows.title: Find a client by policy number
rows.notes: 3+ characters, ignores case, spaces and dashes, shared by the header, Clients card and phone search.

rows.title: Phone client search placeholder
rows.notes: The phone placeholder reads "Name, phone or policy no." and fits at 390 width without clipping.

rows.title: /agent/clients/:clientId: one page per client, with the Servicing plan gate
rows.notes: Route beside /agent/clients (agent + admin, AdminTo /admin/pipeline). :clientId is a lead id or a booking id. Unknown id shows Client not found with a back link. gateView counts /agent/clients/<id> as a Servicing page. Drawer and phone sheet link to it. Shots and checks: qa/goal-check-134a9cda/shots.mjs.

rows.title: Request a service from the client page: opens the request form with this client picked
rows.notes: Shown only when submit_live is on and the agent has Servicing. Link /agent/submit?kind=request&policy=<newest policy id>. ServiceRequest preselects it and looks up a lead client's new policy (useClientPolicies); an unknown id leaves the normal picker. A lead with no policy yet shows it disabled: Available once the policy is placed. The old Coming soon button is gone.

rows.title: One card per policy: carrier, product, premium, dates and the servicing timeline
rows.notes: Each step shows its done date or scheduled time; chargeback watch is month n of 12. Open requests have their own card with status. Draft dates are not stored on policies, so only Effective, Placed and Replaced show. The Text consent card shows only for bookings with policies.sms_consent true, with the existing script and no new wording.

rows.title: Times in the agent's zone with the client's beside it
rows.notes: formatDual(iso, agentTz, clientTz) gives 2:00 PM your time / 1:00 PM client; one time when the zones read the same or the client zone is unknown. Client zone: a booking's saved zone, else the state's zone (city lookup for split states).

rows.title: Sidebar card: N of cap submissions used this week
rows.notes: Always says submissions ("2 of 16 submissions"), whether or not the Submit switch is on; it used to say bookings until Submit went live. Limit reached branch and aria-label unchanged. Last checked 2026-11-01 with scripts/overview-copy-fix-shots.mjs (1440 and 1100, light and dark: the nowrap line is not clipped).

rows.title: Up next with no calls booked: "No calls booked. Submit your next client when they say yes."
rows.notes: Copy only. The slim card (1280+ wide, 700+ tall) says the full line under an Up next header that already says No calls booked, so the phrase shows twice there on purpose. The wider layout shows the heading No calls booked. above Submit your next client when they say yes. A phone gets PhoneHome, which shows neither. Shots: qa/overview-copy-fix.

check.pattern: No calls booked. Submit your next client when they say yes.
